rationale: The plan matches the reference: it recognises the perfect aliasing, formally shows the rank deficiency, fits ~condition only, forbids ComBat/removeBatchEffect/SVA, and forces the confounding caveat onto every artifact, with a sensible sensitivity layer (edgeR QL, leave-one-out) and a statement of the design change actually needed. QC is thorough (library size, detected genes, VST PCA, correlation heatmap, both annotations) though the outlier/shallow-sample policy is only implicit via the no-dropping rule. Weaknesses: the low-count threshold value is never stated numerically, size-factor normalisation is implied rather than named, the reference level is not explicitly set, and the |log2FC|>1 cut is applied post hoc rather than via lfcThreshold in the test. Enrichment names the collections and the ranked-list approach but gives no collection version, size window, or explicit ORA universe, and the ranking metric is left to be decided at run time.
